name: Preacher Curl
common_faults: not reaching full elbow extension at the bottom (loses stretch stimulus)
heaving the upper body to initiate
locking out aggressively causing elbow stress

substitutions.note: standing; allows more load but also more cheating

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded elbow flexion in the lengthened position
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom of the range in the lengthened position; pad removes ability to use body momentum

provenance.notes: Preacher bench removes momentum and isolates the elbow flexors. EZ bar reduces wrist supination demand. Good for developing peak contraction and stretch-position loading.
